punchline: Creative people in Csikszentmihalyi's interviews were energetic and restful, smart and naive, playful and disciplined, all at once.
thirty_sec: Csikszentmihalyi interviewed about 91 exceptional people and found no single creative trait, but pairs of opposites held together: energetic and restful, playful and disciplined, passionate and objective. He cites Vasari's story of Uccello up all night over perspective, and the historian Natalie Davis stepping back from her own writing to take criticism.
